description: The tier list for one category: members in order with tier, score, the score components, per-store search ranks, membership status (active), confidence (normal|provisional), maker verification, freshness. Each ranked member carries a compact app (name, one-liner, price, rating, links); unranked and under_review entries carry a smaller one (name, rating, links). Full details of any app are at its api_url, or get_app. Positions are only meaningful within this category. Tier E means a good score, ranked below the top 100 (members past the first 100 are in unranked with their tier and position). under_review lists the apps not yet checked against this category's definition (review_status: "under_review"): they have no tier and no position, come after every ranked app, and should not be presented as ranked. ranking_status "under_review" means fewer than 6 apps are checked and "too_few" fewer than 6 apps in all, so the category has no ranking yet. An app whose missing_since is set was removed from the App Store (missing_since is the first day we saw it gone, so it is gone since at least then): it stays in the category at tier F, after every app still on sale, and is never counted or named #1; do not recommend it or send anyone to its store_url. A merged category's slug answers with the category it was merged into, with merged_from.

limit.description: max members to return (default 20; 100 is every member shown in full; the rest are unranked entries with their tier and position)

name: get_category
title: Get a category's ranking
